$comment: Default stake-tier rooms (remediation C2). Tier configs live here — server config, not code. Casuals never share a room with 100× their stake: Skiff 1–50, Schooner 5–500, Flagship 50–5000 credits. botsAllowed only takes effect under LANDFALL_ENV=demo; any other environment refuses to start if a room requests bots (C5). LIQUIDITY: seedMinor is the CEILING (a dead table); the house tops the table up to liquidityFloorMinor and then falls away to minSeedMinor as real players arrive — a large flat seed averages the pools together and flattens every payout to the same number (see packages/core/src/liquidity.ts).
